scope: Offline analysis of one preserved S9 first-close profile and exact source; no code edit, test, COM, SWD or Flash

external_procedural_assumptions.S4_restored_after_this_experiment: reported by root, already done; no policy for future mandatory rollbacks inferred

supported_mechanism: The sixth DMA half enters with next_index2560 and head1920 (five occupied slots); three DATA128 chunks fill slots6..8 and the fourth, first_index2944, is rejected. This reconstruction uses exact single-foreground queue ownership and the frozen indices, not an inferred ADC fault.
The consumer committed only fifteen DATA128 blocks before first-close; eight more admitted blocks remained queued. Final wire2944 includes later drain and is not active committed1920.
Each observed ZERO_SPACE means the full remaining frame did not fit into the384-byte CDC FIFO at actual live_write. It is known zero acceptance, not an error or a500us wait loop.

The exact outer PRIMASK covers mt_live_device_step, including possible new frame build/encode and subsequent completion CRC/queue publication. Pure frame construction therefore delays already-admitted USB IRQ progress while it executes.

Final IN completion deliberately holds IRQ and queues an event; BUSY/CLAIMED is cleared by later foreground task dispatch before another transfer can be armed. This is a real dependency, not a measured timing decomposition.
not_established: No per-call profile distinguishes newly built versus cached TX frames; the almost constant ZERO duration does not prove fourteen fresh encodes.
The profile does not isolate encoding cost, exact PRIMASK duration or a specific first/steady-state USB gap.
Maximum IN gap5.449ms may include the natural START_ACK-to-first-DATA wait for the5.12ms DMA half; it does not prove a host or USB scheduling stall.
Queue-full does not by itself prove insufficient long-run average CPU/USB capacity; the31ms window contains start boundaries and a single burst history.
Neither measured100k losslessness nor a maximum feasible Fs nor impossibility of200k follows.

observer_limits.note: Only a heuristic indicator for raw-read probes. Max calibration is not WCET; low indicator does not bound actual observer perturbation.

one_next_correction.name: Separate pure TX frame preparation from the atomic write/commit transaction
one_next_correction.classification: bounded design proposal, not approved or implemented
one_next_correction.change: Prepare only a missing frame in existing staging storage before the outer IRQ guard; perform the original validation, deadline observations, live_write and post-write/sequence/prefix/queue publication inside the transaction. Preparation must have no callbacks or core-state/queue/sequence commit; report preparation failure to the guarded path.
one_next_correction.reason: It removes a confirmed avoidable serialization of pure CPU encoding and already-admitted USB progress, without inventing a lower Fs or enlarging loss buffers. It may reduce deferred/zero retry interactions; it does not remove encoder CPU cost or prove sufficient throughput.
required_contract: Sole foreground owns staged bytes and metadata; ISR never mutates queue head, payload or core session. No reentrant core/ADC callback is allowed during preparation. Prepare returns prepared/empty/error with a ticket covering epoch, nonce, generation, sequence, queue head/count; no second staging buffer.

Revalidate the entire prepared ticket (epoch, nonce, generation, sequence, queue head/count), soft lifecycle and deadline immediately before any write. Stale staging cannot be published and cannot advance sequence/pop/prefix.
Retain the guard from actual irreversible write through final timing observation and state publication; retain known-zero, partial/unknown acceptance, delimiter and first-cause semantics.
Never run Stop/quiesce/recovery as a side effect of an unguarded preparation; defer an encoding/preparation error to the original guarded error path.
Existing ADC service and all lifecycle/OUT/SETUP/time/error guards remain; pure preparation must remain bounded below the DMA obligation. No increased queue/FIFO or hidden losses.
Existing staging storage is reused; exact SRAM/stack must be rebuilt and reviewed before hardware.
Existing build_tx mutates tx_* and can call recover; do not merely move that function out of the lock. completed() rolling CRC/recovery stays inside the original post-write transaction.
one_next_correction.minimal_future_evidence: Targeted byte-equivalence and stale-epoch/known-zero/partial-unknown/time-boundary cases plus exact guard/source/ARM resource review, followed only if admitted by one bounded physical run. This analysis starts none of them.
rejected_as_immediate_actions: Allow final-transfer app callbacks in ISR
Attribute all ZERO wall time to a500us timeout
